name: MongoDB Associate Database Administrator
description: MongoDB certification for administrators of self-managed MongoDB deployments. Validates the skills to size, deploy, upgrade, manage, and tune MongoDB in a mission-critical environment. Covers MongoDB philosophy and features, CRUD and indexing from an operational standpoint, replication, sharding, application administration, and server administration (security, backup and recovery, monitoring, performance tuning). Online proctored exam with a pass/fail grade. Recommended: hands-on operational experience with MongoDB.
exportIntroQuestions:
## About this document

This document is a collection of practice exam questions for the **MongoDB Associate Database Administrator** certification. The questions were selected because they represent the operational skills required to run self-managed MongoDB deployments reliably.

### Certification context

This certification validates the ability to administer self-managed MongoDB deployments, including topics such as:

* MongoDB philosophy and features, and the document model from an operational perspective
* CRUD and indexing as they relate to database operations and performance
* Replication: replica set architecture, elections, failover, and read/write concerns
* Sharding: shard keys, chunk distribution, balancing, and scaling out
* Application administration: users, roles, authentication, and authorization
* Server administration: configuration, security, backup and recovery, monitoring, logging, and performance tuning

### About the questions

Each question in this document is independent and should be analyzed as a standalone scenario. Practice exams intentionally present isolated situations, and questions may appear in any order during the actual certification exam. Information from one question should never be assumed to apply to another.

For each scenario, this document includes:

* The original practice exam question.
* An explanation of the reasoning behind the correct answer.
* A discussion of why the remaining options are less appropriate for the stated requirements.

### Learning objective

The primary goal of this material is to develop applied operational judgment for administering MongoDB rather than memorization. The focus should be on deploying, securing, backing up, monitoring, and tuning MongoDB, and on understanding replication and sharding behavior in production.

By studying the reasoning behind each answer, readers can build the administration skills expected for the MongoDB Associate Database Administrator certification exam.

domains.name: Philosophy and Features
domains.description: Domain 1: MongoDB philosophy, the document model, BSON, and core features from an operational perspective.

domains.name: CRUD Operations
domains.description: Domain 2: CRUD operations, query operators, and cursors as they relate to database operations and troubleshooting.

domains.name: Indexing
domains.description: Domain 3: Index types, index management, and using indexes to diagnose and improve query performance.

domains.name: Replication
domains.description: Domain 4: Replica set architecture, elections and failover, oplog, and read/write concerns for high availability.

domains.name: Sharding
domains.description: Domain 5: Sharded cluster architecture, shard key selection, chunk distribution and balancing, and scaling out horizontally.

domains.name: Application Administration
domains.description: Domain 6: Users, roles, authentication, and authorization; managing application access to the database.

domains.name: Server Administration
domains.description: Domain 7: Deployment, configuration, security hardening, backup and recovery, monitoring and logging, upgrades, and performance tuning of self-managed MongoDB.
